# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ndi icabone, Ô Mana yanje, ko Wandemye ngo nkumenye kandi ngo nkusenge. Ndemeje murak' akanya ubuto bwanje n'ubushobozi bwawe, ubworo bwanje nTtunga ryawe. Ntayind'Imana iriho atari Wewe, Utabara mungorane, Uwibeshejeho.
